+# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
+
+import pytest
+
+import attr
+
+
+def added(name, alias=None):
+    return attr.Attribute(
+        name=name,
+        default=attr.NOTHING,
+        validator=None,
+        repr=True,
+        cmp=None,
+        hash=None,
+        init=True,
+        inherited=False,
+        alias=alias,
+    )
+
+
+class TestTransformHook:
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("slots", [False, True])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("kw_only", [False, True])
+    def test_renamed_inherited_collision(self, slots, kw_only):
+        @attr.s(slots=slots)
+        class Base:
+            _token = attr.ib(alias="token")
+
+        def hook(cls, fields):
+            return [
+                fields[0].evolve(name="retained"),
+                fields[1].evolve(name="_token", kw_only=kw_only),
+            ]
+
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc:
+            @attr.s(slots=slots, field_transformer=hook)
+            class Child(Base):
+                other = attr.ib()
+
+        for name in ("token", "retained", "_token"):
+            assert name in str(exc.value)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("alias", [None, "token"])
+    def test_added_collision(self, alias):
+        def hook(cls, fields):
+            return [*fields, added("_added" if alias else "_token", alias)]
+
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc:
+            @attr.s(field_transformer=hook)
+            class C:
+                stored = attr.ib(alias="token")
+
+        for name in ("token", "stored", "_added" if alias else "_token"):
+            assert name in str(exc.value)
+
+    def test_modified_alias_collision(self):
+        def hook(cls, fields):
+            return [fields[0], fields[1].evolve(alias="token", kw_only=True)]
+
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc:
+            @attr.s(field_transformer=hook)
+            class C:
+                _token = attr.ib()
+                other = attr.ib()
+
+        for name in ("token", "_token", "other"):
+            assert name in str(exc.value)
+
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("excluded", [0, 1])
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("default", [attr.NOTHING, 7, attr.Factory(lambda: 7)])
+    def test_non_init_fields_do_not_collide(self, excluded, default):
+        def hook(cls, fields):
+            return [
+                a.evolve(init=False, default=default) if i == excluded else a
+                for i, a in enumerate(fields)
+            ]
+
+        @attr.s(field_transformer=hook)
+        class C:
+            first = attr.ib(alias="token")
+            second = attr.ib(alias="token", kw_only=True)
+
+        c = C(token=3)
+        names = ("first", "second")
+        assert getattr(c, names[1 - excluded]) == 3
+        if default is attr.NOTHING:
+            assert not hasattr(c, names[excluded])
+        else:
+            assert getattr(c, names[excluded]) == 7
+
+    def test_removed_collision_is_ignored(self):
+        def hook(cls, fields):
+            return fields[:1]
+
+        @attr.s(field_transformer=hook)
+        class C:
+            first = attr.ib(alias="token")
+            second = attr.ib(alias="token")
+
+        assert C(token=3).first == 3
+        assert [a.name for a in attr.fields(C)] == ["first"]
+
+    def test_collision_resolved_by_transformer(self):
+        def hook(cls, fields):
+            return [fields[0], fields[1].evolve(alias="other")]
+
+        @attr.s(field_transformer=hook)
+        class C:
+            first = attr.ib(alias="token")
+            second = attr.ib(alias="token")
+
+        c = C(token=3, other=4)
+        assert (c.first, c.second) == (3, 4)
+
+    def test_no_transformer_collision(self):
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError) as exc:
+            @attr.s
+            class C:
+                first = attr.ib(alias="token")
+                second = attr.ib(alias="token")
+
+        for name in ("token", "first", "second"):
+            assert name in str(exc.value)

spec.question: Add a clear validation error for duplicate constructor aliases during attrs class decoration. Alias provenance already works in this snapshot; preserve that behavior. After a field transformer has finished and all default aliases have been resolved, two final init=True fields must not share a constructor alias. Raise ValueError whose message includes the shared alias and both final storage names, instead of letting generated initializer compilation raise SyntaxError. Apply the same validation when no transformer is supplied. Inherited fields and transformer-added fields participate, including aliases derived by stripping leading underscores. Positional and keyword-only fields share one alias namespace. Fields with init=False do not participate, whether or not they have defaults or factories. A collision removed or resolved by the transformer must not be rejected. Return a unified diff against production files only, leaving tests unchanged.
